findings.issue: Not faithful to 北に対して西側にいます, which means 'west side relative to the north', not the compass direction 'north-west'. Sibling sentences (704732/704735) use the faithful 'Relative to the X…' pattern; this one alone merges reference point and side into one direction.
findings.current: I am located on the North-west side.
findings.suggested: Relative to the north, I'm on the west side.

findings.issue: Literal mirror of 歩いていくよ is wrong: 'Go and walk' reverses the component order (歩いて=walk first, いく=go second) and reads as an imperative, while the JP is a declarative '(I/we) will go walking'. The lit_pt ('Andar ir…') mirrors correctly; lit_en does not.
